d: Shikharji ya shri shikharji ya parasnath parvat bharat ke jharkhand rajy ke giridih zile men chhota nagpur pathar par sthit ek pahari hai jo vishv ka sabse mahatvapurn jain tirth sthal bhi hai. 'shri sammed shikharji' ke rup men charchit is puny kshetr men jain dharm ke 24 men se 20 tirthankron ne moksh ki prapti ki. yahin 23 ven tirthakar bhagvan parshvanath ne bhi nirvan prapt kiya tha. mana jata hai ki 24 men se 20 jain tirthankron ne yahan par moksh prapt kiya tha. 1,350 mitar ooncha yah pahar jharkhand ka sabse ooncha sthan bhi hai.
